card.name: Words right after sentence-opening Although
card.fires_on: Mostly the first few words after a sentence-opening "Although" in general web prose (the, a, the subject noun, its verb). Also fires on scattered spots in explanatory math text and on digits inside years.

modes.label: After Although
modes.description: Words in the concessive clause that follows a sentence-initial "Although".

card.writes: It lowers words that mean "although" or "but" in Chinese, German and English, so it seems to expect the concessive clause to continue rather than a second contrast word.
card.plain: It fires inside a clause that starts with "Although", where the sentence is still setting up its contrast.
